# SurfScore External API

> Read-only B2B API for an organisation's own cellular coverage data: walk/drive-test sessions, per-second telemetry (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, PCI, resolved band, ARFCN, GPS), heatmaps, SurfScan router scan sessions, H3 coverage rollups, and session-lifecycle webhooks. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer ss_live_...` (per-org key from https://surfscore.live → avatar → API Keys). JSON envelope `{data, attribution, meta}`; cursor pagination via `data.next_cursor`; 300 req/min/key; errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.

## Docs
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://api.surfscore.live/v1/openapi.json): every endpoint, parameter and response shape
- [Interactive reference](https://api.surfscore.live/v1/docs): browsable version of the spec
- [Cookbook repo](https://github.com/Waveriders-Collective/surfscore-api-cookbook): quickstart README, AGENTS.md with non-obvious rules, runnable examples
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Waveriders-Collective/surfscore-api-cookbook/main/AGENTS.md): read this first if you are a coding agent

## Examples
- [Export one session to CSV](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Waveriders-Collective/surfscore-api-cookbook/main/examples/export_session.sh)
- [Export a whole map/circuit to CSV + GeoJSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Waveriders-Collective/surfscore-api-cookbook/main/examples/export_map.py)
- [Session summary + heatmap grid](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Waveriders-Collective/surfscore-api-cookbook/main/examples/session_report.sh)
- [Webhook listener with signature verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Waveriders-Collective/surfscore-api-cookbook/main/examples/webhook_listener.py)

## Optional
- [Dashboard](https://dashboard.surfscore.live): where the same sessions and maps are viewed by humans; map ids appear in its URLs
- Attribution: `attribution.text` from any response must accompany redistributed data. SurfScore is a trademark of Waveriders Collective Inc.
